title: Minkowski diagrams
description: Follow the same light rays, clocks and events in two frames.

presets.label: Catch a mirror
presets.note: A fixed source sends light after a moving mirror. Closing speed c-v belongs to this frame.

presets.label: Moving light clock · along x
presets.note: Both ends move. The outward and return times have different denominators.

presets.label: Light clock · across y
presets.note: A transverse light path is longer in the ground frame; light still travels at c.

presets.label: Train lightning
presets.note: Ground-simultaneous lightning strikes are not simultaneous in the train frame.

presets.label: Measure a rod
presets.note: Measure both ends at the same time in the measuring frame.

presets.label: Twin journey
presets.note: Compare clocks when they reunite. The traveler changes inertial frames.

presets.label: Pole and barn
presets.note: The barn doors close together in the barn frame; they do not close together in the pole frame.

presets.label: Launch a rocket
presets.note: A rocket launched from a moving ship does not add velocities by ordinary addition.

presets.label: Moving objects
presets.note: Compare the same extended object on simultaneous slices in two frames.

presets.label: Two light flashes
presets.note: Each flash expands at c in both frames, although the emission events have different times.

presets.label: Four-vector
presets.note: The components change while the Minkowski norm stays fixed.

presets.label: Rank-two tensor
presets.note: A rank-two tensor transforms on both indices. Antisymmetric components mix like electric and magnetic fields.
